THE LOCAL MEANING

What it is.

A bass-lodge trip on Lake El Salto in Sinaloa. Lobina is the Spanish sport-fishing name used in the research for largemouth bass. The lake and lodge format make this more specific than a general Mexico bass page.

How it is fished.

Cast bass lures from a guided lake boat.

The trip uses bass lures from a guided lake boat. Ask which presentations suit the current water level and how much tackle the lodge supplies. EDITORIAL PREPARATION ADVICE

What to bring.

  • Sun coverage, glasses, and a light weather layer.
  • Rods packed for the agreed transfer and boat storage.
  • A concise lure list from the lodge instead of an unverified full tackle purchase.
